gloss: one's own funds; personal capital; equity (as opposed to borrowed money)

definitions.gloss: one's own funds; personal capital; own-source funding
definitions.explanation: Money that belongs to the person or company using it, as opposed to money borrowed from a bank or other source. Especially common in discussions of home purchases, starting a business, or investment.

examples.japanese: {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: I don't have enough of my own funds.

examples.japanese: {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Buying a house with one's own funds alone is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦にあたって→にあたって：22936_niatatte⟧、⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自己資金|じこしきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To start a business, you need a certain amount of personal capital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二割|にわり}⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自己資金|じこしきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{望|のぞ}ましい→望ましい：12860_nozomashii⟧。
examples.english: When taking out a home loan, it's advisable to have prepared personal funds equal to about 20% of the property price.

notes:
A financial term that distinguishes one's own money from borrowed money. Composed of ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) + ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧ (funds/capital). Commonly used in banking, real estate, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ / ⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to have (not) enough of one's own funds
- {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare one's own funds
- {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase with one's own funds
- {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: equity ratio (ratio of own funds to total capital)
- {自己資金|じこしきん}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero down payment (no own funds)

SIMILAR WORDS / ANTONYMS:
- ⟦{借入金|かりいれきん}→借入金：29454_kariirekin⟧: borrowed money; loan — the opposite; money borrowed from a bank or other lender
- ⟦{頭金|あたまきん}→頭金：29480_atamakin⟧: down payment — the portion of one's own funds used at the start of a large purchase
- {運転資金|うんてんしきん}: working capital — funds used for day-to-day business operations
- {資本金|しほんきん}: capital (of a company) — the registered capital of a corporation

USAGE:
When applying for a home loan or business loan in Japan, banks typically ask how much {自己資金|じこしきん} the applicant can contribute. A higher {自己資金|じこしきん} ratio usually means better loan terms.
